dct_title_s: Damage assessment in Siargao Island, General Luna, Surigao del Norte of Philippines as of 26 December 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20211216PHL** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in Siargao Island, General Luna, Surigao del Norte of Philippines as detected by Pleiades image acquired on 26 December 2021 and WorldView-3 acquired on 23 December 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 1,769 damaged structures, 380 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
